blocked_requires_request.query: Jimmy Carter personal/public financial disclosure (SF 278 / OGE 278) - repository request
blocked_requires_request.collection_hierarchy: repository:Jimmy Carter Presidential Library (Atlanta GA); White House Central/Staff Office record groups (no individually catalogued FD item located)
blocked_requires_request.note: NULL: no digitized on-topic personal/public financial-disclosure record for Jimmy Carter located across 9 term variants. Closest hits were Ford-era Cheney fileUnit NAID 1561646 'President - Financial Disclosure' 1976, and 1976 Carter campaign material NAID 574324 - neither is a Carter personal SF-278. DRAFT REQUEST (NOT SENT): To Jimmy Carter Presidential Library, carter.library@nara.gov, 441 John Lewis Freedom Pkwy NE, Atlanta GA 30307. Subject: Reference request - public financial disclosure statements (SF-278/OGE Form 278) of President Jimmy Carter, 1977-1981. Body: I am conducting public-records research and seek any publicly releasable financial-disclosure statements (SF-278/OGE Form 278) filed by or on behalf of President James Earl Carter Jr. during 1977-1981, or the finding-aid/box-folder locator for the series containing them. Please advise NAID(s), series title, box/folder, reproduction fees, and whether digitized copies exist. Public records only - no FOIA or nonpublic access requested.

interpretation: A catalog hit (NAID) is a LOCATOR, not an ingested disclosure; only downloaded + hashed items count as acquired.
keyword_result_count is a loose OR-keyword denominator over the whole catalog, NOT a count of disclosure records; top hits can be unrelated collections.
Zero on-topic results are preserved as unavailable_after_search with the exact query, never rewritten as "no record existed."
Modern presidents (Trump, Biden, and most personal SF-278 for Obama/G.W. Bush) are not in NARA as presidential financial-disclosure records; that material lives in OGE's online window.

consumption.what_this_is: A catalog locator index (NAIDs, URLs, keyword denominators) plus one hashed digitized disclosure, for the archival route to older-era records.
consumption.what_this_is_not: A verified disclosure set, a holdings extract, a crossing, or evidence of absence.
consumption.copy_ready_caveat: A NAID locates candidate material; it does not verify a disclosure, and a keyword denominator is not evidence that responsive records exist.
